links.outcome: Self-reported AI knowledge and practical skills among rheumatology professionals
links.effect: Practical skills basic or developing in 346 (75.1%); knowledge strong or expert in only 63 (13.7%); insufficient training a concern for 270 (59.3%).
links.quote: Although there was broad optimism about its use (366, 79.6%), self-reported practical skills were predominantly basic or still in development (346, 75.1%), and knowledge was rarely defined as strong or expert-level (63, 13.7%).

screen.reason: International survey assessing clinicians' use, knowledge, and perceptions of AI and LLMs in rheumatology.
